invariants.rationale: If the template is not null, it is intended as an object per merge semantics.
If the parent is not null, it is used as an object for attribute merging.
At least one of parent or template must be non-null for the merge to be meaningful.
If template is not null, it likely has children as it is being iterated over.
If parent is not null, it likely has children that are being processed.
